Name: Seacliff Farm
Author: FreeTheJunimos
Description:
[size=4][b]DESCRIPTION[/b][/size]
Seacliff Farm is especially designed as a Four Corners replacement, with attractive terrain and diverse resources. It features a small lake fed by a mountain stream via a waterfall, with a substantial above-ground mining area located next to it. An extended waterfall plummets spectacularly from the lake down to the sandy and pristine ocean cove at the bottom of a cliff. Extra foraging is largely focused in a heavily forested region located at the far end of an expansive and grassy valley. A break in the edge of the forest canopy offers access to the ocean cove and the modest bounty which washes to shore there.

[b][size=4]REQUIRED ADDITIONAL MODS
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Farm Type Manager 1.16.0 by Esca
[*]Content Patcher 1.28.1 (or higher, tested up to 1.28.4) by Pathoschild
[/list]
[size=4][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]Same size as Four Corners, with preserved exits from the farmland to matching terrain and the greenhouse
Moderate surface mining
[list]
[*]Lowered mining level requirements for spawning of ores
[*]No gem spawning
[/list]Zone 5 fishing[list]
[*]Small fresh water lake with ecologically responsible fish and seasonal visitors from the Mines
[*]Salt water cove with the usual ocean fish
[*]Fresh water and ocean crab pots
[/list]Full seasonal foraging spawns
[list]
[*]5 Regenerating hardwood stumps
[*]Substantial seasonal berry foraging
[*]Special forest farm weeds which always spawn mixed seeds
[*]Extra seasonal foraging spawns (mushrooms, fiddlehead fern, holly)
[*]Normal beach foraging (no quality) and some Island Farm crate items, plus ocean crab pot fish foragable in the Fall
[/list]Expansive grassy valley for farming
[list]
[*]Some tiered terrain interruptions
[*]Fully tillable grass, dirt, and sand
[*]No hard-coded paving in spouse area or in front of greenhouse
[/list]Compatibility
[list]
[*]Seacliff has not been tested with other (visual/textural/recoloring) mods - Let us know what works or doesn't!
[*]Supports multiplayer
[*]This version is now compatible with Android devices

[/list]Credits
[list]
[*]Map designed using Tiled from mapeditor.org
[*]Waterfall Reversion For SVE from Niteslash
[*]Waterfall edge image from SVE
[*]And of course the massive amount of artwork from ConcernedApe
[*]Massive thanks to the designers of Farm Type Manager, Content Patcher, and everyone who has provided supportive documentation
[/list]
